verdict.rationale: Fellow documents configurable organization-wide retention policies, including zero-day retention. Its Super Admin API lets Enterprise administrators delete data across the workspace, including deleting notes through the API, to meet privacy regulations. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how retention policies are configured (retention claims come only from marketing copy), deletion controls for non-super-admin users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Set configurable retention policies, including zero-day retention, so data is handled according to your organization’s requirements.
Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained

Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace, making it simple to back up notes and transcripts for legal purposes and to erase third‑party data in line with privacy regulations.
Only users with super admin privileges can delete notes through the API.
